Metro: Commercial Building Permit Intakes Report

Learn more about Bureau of Development Services permits. There are several types of permits reports available in the Building menu.

Sort, filter and search using any of the following:

  • Permit details: Select a link to get all the details about a permit.
  • Click any column header to sort by that header. For example, click Type of Use to sort results alphabetically by project type.
  • Filter results by date. Enter the start and end dates, select date received or date issued and click submit.
  • Filter results by search term. Enter the search field and term - use search term % (like %hotel%) to widen search results.
  • You can also create reports. Filter results by date or by search term and then select the report type (CSV, JSON or XML).
  • Review older weekly and monthly metro reports.

     Accessibility

    The City of Portland is committed to providing meaningful access to all users. While the City strives to increase the accessibility of its digital maps, you may encounter a map that is not compatible with all screen reader technology. To request translation, map interpretation, modifications, or other auxiliary aids or services, call 311 (503-823-4000), for Relay Service & TTY: 711, or visit Request an ADA Accommodation .
